verdict.rationale: LathamDrive organizes founder resources by stage, starting with "Formation". It offers an incorporation document generator, lawyer-answered FAQs, and the firm advertises tailored company formation services, so some formation guidance is published. Nothing in the evidence shows content that actually compares entity types or jurisdictions of incorporation. Missing for 10: explicit published guidance on choosing an entity type, a comparison of Delaware C-corp vs UK Ltd vs German GmbH/UG vs Indian Pvt Ltd, market-specific jurisdiction advice, and independent corroboration.
